name: Australia
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Australian Shiraz is medium to full bodied and is grown in warm regions as well as moderate to cool ones.
Australian Riesling is traditionally fermented fully dry, with high acidity and vibrant citrus fruit, and it can age for decades.
Australian Chardonnay made its name with big fruit and easy drinking, while cooler regions now make crisper, less oaked wines with lime notes.
Some Shiraz is made sparkling, traditionally a little sweet, though dry versions exist.

blurb.text: One of the world's largest wine exporters, sending about 613 million of its roughly 1.1 billion liters abroad in 2025. Wine is made in every state, and South Australia makes about half. Shiraz is the most planted grape at 30 percent, then Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay.
